server.name: io.github.aethynio/aethyn-browser-mcp
server.description: Local Playwright browser through residential proxies — agent picks country + sticky identity

environmentVariables.description: Aethyn proxy username (e.g. aethyn-XXXXX). Omit if using a custom proxy via PROXY_*.
environmentVariables.name: AETHYN_USERNAME

environmentVariables.description: Aethyn proxy password (or PROXY_PASSWORD for a custom proxy).
environmentVariables.name: AETHYN_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Default proxy tier: premium (port 2099) or elite (port 5499).
environmentVariables.name: AETHYN_DEFAULT_TIER
